info.name: Advanced Webforms
info.summary: Forms with conditional logic, grid layouts, and after-submit actions
info.description:
**Forms with the features larger form builders have, self-hosted.**
- **Rules engine:** show, hide, or require fields based on earlier answers, with nested AND/OR conditions. - **Grid layout:** put several fields on one row, responsive on small screens. - **After-submit actions:** confirmation email, webhook, confirmation message, or redirect, each with optional conditions. - **Your data stays on your server.**
This app is in early development.
info.author: Adam Arcane
